title: Installment Change Set
description: Installment-level membership actions for one proposal refinement, each naming the purchase it applies to by product_id and the installment by its canonical (collection_ref, installment_id) tuple. A tuple cannot be an object key, so this is a list rather than a map; entries are unique by (product_id, collection_ref, installment_id), so contradictory actions for one installment of one purchase cannot be represented.

product_id.description: Product whose purchase in commercial_terms.purchases carries the installment.

installment_ref.description: Installment the action applies to. It MUST be one the named product's installments declare; an unresolvable reference is rejected at task level with REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND rather than returned as an unsatisfied change.

action.description: include requires the installment to be present in that purchase's installments in every returned draft; omit requires its absence. Swapping a slot is one omit plus one include in the same refinement.
